decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith,including alabaster composite cladding and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to the completion of work.

Condition : 3 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of   8am  to  6pm  on Mondays to Friday and  9am  to 12.30pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and public holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Replacement of existing cladding at 3rd, 4th and roof level incorporating replacement windows at 3rd and 4th level of existing building.
